headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins. The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Boston Red Sox 8-4, and the Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers 9-5.

Top MLB news saw the Cardinals fall to the Cubs in a 0-3 shutout, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense. The Reds took down the Marlins in a 1-0 thriller, with Chase Burns pitching a stellar 7.0 innings and Eugenio Suárez leading the Reds' offense. The Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Red Sox, and the White Sox took down the Tigers 9-5, led by Miguel Vargas' dominant performance.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with the Milwaukee Brewers placing Abner Uribe on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The Seattle Mariners placed Colt Emerson on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation. The Chicago White Sox placed Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants transferred Matt Chapman to the 60-day injured list with an abdominal strain and Trevor McDonald to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. The Boston Red Sox placed Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers placed James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, and the Pittsburgh Pirates placed Endy Rodríguez on the 10-day injured list with left hip inflammation.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade, and the Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Matthew Liberatore pitched 5.1 innings for the Cardinals, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a stellar 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a crucial double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit performance, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by a dominant performance from their offense. Miguel Vargas led the charge with a 4-hit, 2-home run game, including a 27th homer of the season on a fly ball to left center field.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox on August 12, 2026, as part of a trade. The deal is tied to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
